task.payload: {"metadata":{"description":"Customize DSH Web thinking status with custom flowing text, animated GIF/APNG/WebP, or combined image-and-text modes.","id":"gh:1334032768","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-thinking-status-customizer","slug":"Dbi-Eshuh/dsh-thinking-status-customizer","topics":["animated-gif","cordis","css","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","gif","i18n","localization","thinking-status","web-ui"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Customize DSH Web thinking status with custom flowing text, animated GIF/APNG/WebP, or combined imag"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" thinking status with custom flowing text, animated GIF/APNG/WebP, or combined image-and-text modes."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Thinking Status Customizer"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A CSS-only DSH Web plugin that replaces the visible running status with custom flowing text, a GIF/A"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"PNG/WebP animation, or a combined image-and-text display without modifying DSH source or rewriting t"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"tion, or a combined image-and-text display without modifying DSH source or rewriting the status DOM."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Preview"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"### Dark theme"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### Light theme"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### Settings panel"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Install the tagged release into a Web profile, inspect the resolved configuration, then restart DSH "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"all the tagged release into a Web profile, inspect the resolved configuration, then restart DSH Web:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Open the floating **Thinking status** button after restart. Click the same button again, use the clo"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"se button, or press Escape to close the panel. The plugin follows the active DSH language setting an"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"d updates its English or Chinese interface immediately without discarding unsaved form values; user-"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"authored custom text is preserved verbatim. The dialog can enable or disable the visual replacement "},{"id":"p12s5","text":"and switch among custom text with a flow effect, an animated image, and a left-image/right-text comb"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"ination. Text modes support two to five custom colors, four flow directions, and continuous or back-"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"and-forth movement. Image modes include a roughly 12-second dance GIF with a transparent background "},{"id":"p12s8","text":"and also accept an HTTPS/Data URL or a local GIF, APNG, or WebP up to 20 MB. Local files above 2 MB "},{"id":"p12s9","text":"remain uncompressed and use a temporary object URL, so they work only in the current tab and must be"},{"id":"p12s10","text":" selected again after a reload."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The settings panel inherits DSH Web's light or dark theme tokens and previews text, color count, col"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ors, flow direction, movement pattern, animation, and size edits before they are saved."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Remove the plugin and restart DSH Web to restore the built-in presentation:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Behavior and privacy"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The default mode is the custom text `正在吃饭中...` with a flow effect. Settings and Data URL images up t"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"o about 3 MB are stored only in browser `localStorage` under `dsh-thinking-status-customizer:v1`; la"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"rger local images use a temporary object URL and are not persisted. The plugin does not upload setti"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ngs, status text, images, or model interaction. When an HTTPS image URL is configured, the browser r"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"equests that URL directly. Missing, corrupt, or unavailable storage resolves to defaults without sto"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"L directly. Missing, corrupt, or unavailable storage resolves to defaults without stopping the page."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The stylesheet targets only `[data-conversation-scroll] [role=\"status\"][aria-live=\"polite\"]`. It add"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"s a layout-participating pseudo-element and plugin-owned CSS properties; it does not observe the pag"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"e, replace `textContent`, or target other live-status elements. Disabling or unloading the plugin re"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"moves its style, controls, attributes, CSS properties, and event listeners."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The original DSH status remains in the accessibility tree. This plugin therefore changes visual copy"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" only; assistive technology continues to receive the built-in status text."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The current release is tested with DSH Web `0.1.0-rc.6`. A DSH update"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" that changes the selector can make the visual replacement inactive; the plugin remains loaded and i"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ts dialog reports that it is waiting for a matching status."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"This package uses only the public DSH bundle, client-module loading declarations, and client locale "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"service.
